title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
summary: Talorys is a self-hosted personal AI agent built to run entirely on Cloudflare's free tier infrastructure, allowing users to have their own private AI assistant without subscription costs.
problem_solved: Provides a free, privacy-focused alternative to commercial AI assistants by self-hosting on Cloudflare's infrastructure.
why_valuable: It eliminates both cost barriers and privacy concerns by enabling users to deploy a personal AI agent for free while keeping data under their control.
